critique: The render strongly matches the expected Flight Plasma character: a wide, dense magenta-violet fractal particle ribbon on black with layered flowing sheets and bright plasma filaments. Unlike the prior iteration, frames 1 and 4 now have clearly different contour layouts, confirming active animated evolution. The remaining issue is that the dense central overlaps clip toward near-white, making the middle read as a blown-out luminous band and obscuring some of the fine particle structure that is visible around the edges.

suggestions.why: Slightly reduce the particle color intensity so dense intersecting particle sheets retain magenta detail rather than clipping into a broad white-hot center.
